findings.summary: Full validate CLI accepts an unsupported PASS observation without a command, artifact/hash or source snapshot. It also accepts JSON false as exit code zero.
findings.expected: Reject incomplete execution evidence and non-integer exits without changing closed authority state.

findings.component: Report CI and source identity binding
findings.summary: Full report CLI accepts in_progress CI with success, nonexistent CI evidence, an all-zero CI head, and a nonexistent observed-main/original-stage-base tuple.
findings.expected: Bind CI rows to listed hash-checked observation artifacts and coherent run/source/status fields; verify declared Git identities and applicable ancestry. Offline consistency is not provider authenticity.

findings.summary: Keeping original immutable inputs/anchor/current task intact, repointing only the mutable task spec at a self-authored matching manifest produces a successful M0-02 ZIP containing unapproved synthetic text.
findings.expected: Resolve approved issue identity independently of mutable spec-supplied pointers/hashes; no self-authored same-task approval can authorize a new allowlist.

findings.summary: A dangling output-file symlink passes the exists-based precheck. touch() creates an empty file outside the root before safe_file rejects the link.
findings.expected: Validate lexical target and ancestors before any creation/write; rejection cannot create or alter outside-root or link-target files.
findings.limitation: Actual Linux filesystem with five Git-byte-matched function slices; input validation and generated data are inert stubs. Not a full Linux repository/CLI test.
